content_sections.text: The engagement is open to eligible dependents of serving or retired Central Government employees. Candidates must also satisfy the post-wise educational qualification, experience and age requirements.

content_sections.heading: Age Relaxation
content_sections.text: For most posts, relaxation of up to five years may be allowed to candidates possessing higher qualifications or experience. For Peon and Caretaker posts, relaxation of up to 10 years is available to ex-servicemen.

faq.question: Q1. What is the last date to apply for Grih Kalyan Kendra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The completed application must reach Grih Kalyan Kendra on or before 28 September 2026.

faq.question: Q2. Who is eligible to apply for GKK Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Eligible dependents of serving or retired Central Government employees who satisfy the post-wise qualification and age requirements can apply.

faq.question: Q3. What posts are available under Grih Kalyan Kendra Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: The available posts include Office Assistant, Accounts Assistant, Zonal Assistant, Craft Teacher, Day Care Teacher, Day Care Attendant, Data Entry Operator, Peon, Nursery Teacher, Nursery Attendant, Booking Clerk and Caretaker.

faq.question: Q4. What is the honorarium for Grih Kalyan Kendra posts?
faq.answer: The monthly honorarium ranges from Rs. 7,000 to Rs. 18,000, depending on the post.

faq.question: Q5. How can candidates submit the GKK application form?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit the prescribed application form offline to Grih Kalyan Kendra (HQ), Samaj Sadan, Lodhi Road Complex, New Delhi – 110003.
